svg.title: Vajbratya GitHub Flight Control
svg.desc: A radial mission-control visualization of 5,891 GitHub contributions over the last 365 days.

g.text: Not a heatmap. A launch console.
365-day output as orbital telemetry, monthly thrust, and weekday behavior. Click any glowing dot for the exact GitHub day.
Average contributions per weekday. This shows when the engine usually runs hottest.

svg.text: SELF-HOSTED ON GITHUB / NO THIRD-PARTY GRAPH ENGINE / UPDATED 2026-09-12
CLICK A DOT TO OPEN THE EXACT DAY
